title: The Unexpected Semester
author: Gideon Delacroix
blurb: Coral Villalobos, the only out kid in a town of nine hundred, counts days until graduation like a sentence being served. Then grandma's recipe box contains directions that aren't for food — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must save the tradition that made the town, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
